stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: The museum displays an old gun behind safety glass.
items.sentenceZh: 博物馆把一支古老的枪陈列在安全玻璃后。
items.scene: Inside a history museum, one antique unloaded flintlock gun rests horizontally on a secure stand behind a thick glass display case while an adult curator explains it to visitors. The object is clearly historical and inaccessible, with no ammunition, action, threat, labels or readable text.
items.altText: 历史博物馆的安全玻璃柜中陈列着一支古老的燧发枪。

items.sentenceEn: We meet at the station before the train arrives.
items.sentenceZh: 我们在火车到站前于车站会合。
items.scene: Two adult friends greet each other beneath the broad roof of a railway station while an approaching train is still visible far down the tracks. Platforms, benches, rails and waiting travelers clearly establish the station without signs, clocks, letters or numbers.
items.altText: 两位朋友在火车尚未进站时于铁路车站会合。

items.sentenceEn: She chooses the blue umbrella in the rain.
items.sentenceZh: 她在雨中选择了那把蓝色雨伞。
items.scene: At a covered market stall during rain, an adult woman opens and chooses one vivid blue umbrella from a small group of closed neutral gray and beige umbrellas. The saturated blue color is unmistakable against the muted rainy scene.
items.altText: 雨天里，一名女子从灰色和米色雨伞中选出蓝色雨伞。

items.sentenceEn: Their strategy guides the team around the blocked road.
items.sentenceZh: 他们的策略引导团队绕过被堵塞的道路。
items.scene: A diverse adult rescue team gathers around a text-free raised terrain model, tracing a deliberate alternate route around a visibly collapsed road toward an isolated village. One leader moves small vehicle pieces along the safe route while teammates coordinate supplies.
items.altText: 救援队围着地形模型规划绕过塌方道路的安全路线。

items.sentenceEn: The lighthouse beam can be seen clearly through the fog.
items.sentenceZh: 灯塔的光束穿过雾气仍能被清楚地看见。
items.scene: A strong lighthouse beam forms one crisp bright path through dense soft fog toward a small boat, sharply distinguishable from the obscured coastline and blurred sea. The contrast makes clear visibility the central visual idea.
items.altText: 灯塔光束形成清晰明亮的路径，穿过浓雾照向小船。

items.sentenceEn: The neighbors discuss how to share the community garden.
items.sentenceZh: 邻居们商议如何共享社区花园。
items.scene: Four adult neighbors sit in a circle inside a community garden, listening and taking turns gesturing toward shared vegetable beds and watering tools. Open postures, attentive faces and balanced participation clearly communicate a cooperative discussion.
items.altText: 四位邻居在社区花园中围坐，轮流讨论共享菜地的方法。

items.sentenceEn: The tiny seed did indeed grow into a tall sunflower.
items.sentenceZh: 那颗小种子确实长成了一株高大的向日葵。
items.scene: A continuous garden scene shows a tiny planted seed in early spring on the left and the same marked patch later holding one exceptionally tall blooming sunflower on the right. Matching soil, pot border and viewpoint make the confirmed transformation unmistakable without arrows or text.
items.altText: 同一块花圃中，小种子后来确实长成一株高大的向日葵。

items.sentenceEn: The clear footprint reveals the truth about which animal visited.
items.sentenceZh: 清晰的脚印揭示了究竟是哪种动物来过。
items.scene: A naturalist kneels beside a crisp fox footprint in soft mud and follows a visible trail to a red fox partly emerging from distant bushes. Other possible animal tracks diverge and fade, while the matching paw shape reveals the true visitor.
items.altText: 自然观察者沿着清晰脚印发现灌木后的狐狸，从而弄清真相。

items.sentenceEn: Her song draws the quiet crowd toward the stage.
items.sentenceZh: 她的歌声吸引安静的人群走向舞台。
items.scene: An adult singer performs into a simple microphone on a small outdoor stage at twilight while a quiet crowd turns and moves closer, visibly absorbed by her voice. Flowing fabric and attentive expressions suggest music without notes, symbols or text.
items.altText: 黄昏舞台上歌手演唱，安静的人群被歌声吸引靠近。

items.sentenceEn: The instructor uses one red apple as an example of a fruit.
items.sentenceZh: 讲师用一个红苹果作为水果的例子。
items.scene: An adult instructor holds exactly one red apple forward while learners observe a nearby assortment of other fruits including pear, orange and grapes. Her gesture clearly presents the apple as one concrete member of the broader fruit group, with no board or labels.
items.altText: 讲师举起一个红苹果，将它作为水果的具体例子。

items.sentenceEn: The club makes a democratic choice by letting every member vote.
items.sentenceZh: 俱乐部让每位成员投票，以民主方式作出选择。
items.scene: A diverse adult community club gathers around a transparent ballot box as every member places one plain colored token into it in turn. Equal access, one token per person and respectful observation communicate a democratic decision without ballots, letters or campaign signs.
items.altText: 俱乐部每位成员依次投入一个彩色筹码，平等参与投票。

items.meaningZh: 检查；支票；阻止物；寄物牌；象棋中将
items.sentenceEn: The mechanic will check every wheel before the bus leaves.
items.sentenceZh: 公交车出发前，机械师会检查每个车轮。
items.scene: An adult mechanic methodically inspects the visible tires and wheel bolts of a parked bus while the driver waits beside the closed door. A pressure gauge without numbers and careful hand inspection make the safety check clear before departure.
items.altText: 公交车出发前，机械师逐个检查车轮和螺栓。

items.sentenceEn: A healthy pond environment supports frogs, fish, and reeds.
items.sentenceZh: 健康的池塘环境滋养着青蛙、鱼和芦苇。
items.scene: A cutaway view of one healthy pond shows clear water, fish below the surface, frogs on lily pads, dragonflies above and dense reeds rooted along the shore. The interconnected habitat and surrounding conditions are the main subject.
items.altText: 清澈池塘中鱼、青蛙、蜻蜓和芦苇共同构成健康环境。

items.sentenceEn: She stretches one leg before the race.
items.sentenceZh: 比赛前她伸展一条腿。
items.scene: An adult runner at a track places one clearly visible leg straight onto a low bench and leans forward to stretch it while her other leg supports her body. Other runners warm up softly in the background with natural anatomy.
items.altText: 成年跑者在赛前把一条腿伸直放在矮凳上拉伸。

items.sentenceEn: The tunnel grows dark beyond the last lamp.
items.sentenceZh: 越过最后一盏灯后，隧道逐渐变暗。
items.scene: Inside a stone tunnel, one final warm lamp illuminates the near walkway while the passage beyond it visibly fades into deep darkness. A lone adult explorer stops safely before the boundary, emphasizing the transition from light to dark.
items.altText: 石隧道在最后一盏灯之后逐渐没入黑暗。

items.sentenceEn: The market sells various kinds of fresh fruit.
items.sentenceZh: 市场出售各种各样的新鲜水果。
items.scene: A market stall overflows with clearly different fresh fruits arranged in baskets: apples, pears, oranges, bananas, grapes, melons, berries and pineapples. An adult vendor offers the broad assortment to shoppers without price tags or signs.
items.altText: 市场摊位的篮子里摆着多种颜色和形状各异的新鲜水果。

items.sentenceEn: He would rather walk through the park than wait in traffic.
items.sentenceZh: 他宁愿穿过公园步行，也不愿在车流中等待。
items.scene: At a clear fork in his commute, an adult man leaves a stationary line of cars and happily chooses a green walking path through a park toward the same distant destination. His movement and expression show a definite preference for walking.
items.altText: 男子离开堵塞的车流，选择穿过公园步行前往目的地。

items.sentenceEn: The friends laugh together at the playful puppy.
items.sentenceZh: 朋友们看着顽皮的小狗一起大笑。
items.scene: Three adult friends sit on a park picnic blanket laughing openly as a playful puppy tumbles backward while trying to catch a soft ball. Every face has clear joyful eyes, nose, mouth and a natural laughing expression.
items.altText: 三位朋友看着追球翻倒的顽皮小狗开心大笑。

items.sentenceEn: She studies the three covered boxes and makes a guess.
items.sentenceZh: 她观察三个盖着的盒子并作出猜测。
items.scene: An adult woman thoughtfully studies exactly three closed boxes with distinct shapes, listens to each and then tentatively points to the middle one. The contents remain completely hidden, making her uncertain choice clearly a guess.
items.altText: 女子观察正好三个密闭盒子，犹豫地猜测中间一个。

items.meaningZh: 执行部门；执行委员会；执行者；经理主管
items.sentenceEn: The executive leads a planning meeting for the new factory.
items.sentenceZh: 这位主管主持新工厂的规划会议。
items.scene: A senior adult executive confidently leads a meeting around a table with engineers and operations managers, directing attention toward a detailed scale model of a new factory. Her central leadership, decision-making posture and the team's attention establish the executive role without screens or text.
items.altText: 企业主管在会议桌旁带领团队规划新工厂模型。
